rationale: This concerns assembling the deployment-diff inventory used as the reduction input. Establishing it supplies the candidate parts without changing the removal mechanism or the bounded, test-relative inference. The mapping does not claim that the retained set excludes every competing production cause.

if_execution.verification_or_satisfaction_method: Enumerate and reconcile the changes between the last known-good and regressed deployments across code, configuration, feature flags, dependencies and infrastructure.
